premise.title: The quiet shrines
paragraphs: The Verdant Isles used to hum with light. Four crystal shrines kept the trails safe and the wild friends close.
For years the shrines have been quiet. The ranger at camp believes a bond with the creatures of the grass could wake them.
Find a friend in the tall grass, wake the Meadow shrine, and explore the quiet cut-through in the ruined orchard before following the blue markers to Amber Ridge, Frostveil Grove, and Reedfen.

hints.text: Tip: weaken it with strikes, then throw a capture orb (3). The lower its health, the better the chance.
Tip: low on health? Drink a potion (4), Guard (5) or switch friends (6). Resting with the ranger is free.
Tip: you can switch friends mid-battle (6). A creature strong against the foe's type hits much harder.
Tip: rest here whenever you like: it heals everyone and tops up your orbs for free.

ending.title: The isles are awake
paragraphs: The last seal glows, and for a moment the whole isle hums together: meadow, ridge, grove, and wetland.
The trails are safe again. The friends you made gather at the shore to watch the shrines shine.
The adventure is complete, but the isles are still yours. Wander back, find the friends you have not met, and rest wherever you like.
